extension.description: Standalone Chaturbate Kodi addon with priority-based TV mode, local favorites, and HLS playback through a localhost rewriting proxy.
extension.news:
0.7.24 - The biocontext breakthrough. Discovered that /api/biocontext/<slug>/ -- which 404s without a Referer header -- returns HTTP 200 with the full public profile JSON when given Referer: https://chaturbate.com/p/<slug>/. ONE request per model gives us last_broadcast (with timestamp), real_name, display_age, location, follower_count, sex/subgender, body_type/decorations, smoke_drink, fan_club info, photo_sets (cover_url + paywalled tease), social_medias, full bio_about_html and wish_list -- enough to populate offline-favs with rich metadata even for accounts we've never seen broadcasting in our 9k bulk feed.
Schema bumped to v3 with 20+ new bio_* columns (auto-migrates v2 -> v3 via ALTER TABLE). New upsert_biocontext helper INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE COALESCEs every column except the always-overwrite ones, with last_online_epoch protected by MAX so a higher bulk-poll observation isn't lowered. Deep refresh now calls biocontext FIRST and only falls back to status+thumb-HEAD when biocontext returns empty (network failure or account gone) -- corroborates the "deleted account" case while reducing requests from 2 per slug to 1 in the common path. Per-row ctxmenu refresh likewise upgraded to biocontext primary; toast notification surfaces "<slug>: <status> -- last broadcast <time>".
Offline favs render gets two new lines: "Last broadcast: 3h ago" (parses biocontext's ISO timestamp; falls back to time_since_last_broadcast string when no parseable epoch) and "Verified: 12m ago" (last_status_check_epoch). image_for_row now synthesizes https://thumb.live.mmcdn.com/ri/<slug>.jpg when thumb_available=1 so models we've only ever seen via biocontext still get a thumbnail. real_name takes over as the subject line when no last_subject is cached.
New configurable setting: deep_refresh_rate_seconds (default 2, range 1-30, slider in General settings). Ban-risk dial: bump it up to 10 if CB starts rate-limiting; bump it down to 1 to crawl a 1228-fav list in 20 min instead of 40. addon_settings.deep_refresh_rate_seconds() accessor reads it with the standard floor/ceil/default fallback.
Twelve new tests covering schema migration v2 -> v3, upsert_biocontext writes/overlays/empty-input, image_for_row synthesis precedence (cached > photo_set_cover > synth thumb), plot_for_offline_row last_broadcast / verified / real_name lines, and the deep_refresh primary-vs-fallback branching.
0.7.23 - Two refinements on the meta-refresh story. (1) Per-row "Update model info" context menu entry on every model row in browse views, favs, and TV list -- right-click any model and trigger a single-slug AJAX status + thumb HEAD probe that upserts to the DB. Synchronous (~2s); good for "I want to know if this ONE model is still around" without waiting 20 minutes for the deep crawl. (2) Spinner fix on both refresh menu entries: previously clicking "Refresh offline model info" or "Deep refresh" would leave Kodi's busy dialog up the entire time the bg thread ran (could be 20 min for the deep crawl). Now both handlers call xbmcplugin.endOfDirectory(handle, succeeded=False) right after spawning the daemon so Kodi releases the spinner immediately and the user can keep using the menus while the work continues silently. New refresh_one_model handler + entry in router. Six new tests covering ctxmenu integration (entry present in all TV/favs membership states), spinner-fix behavior for both refresh menus, refresh_one_model success + empty-slug paths.
0.7.22 - Deep per-fav status crawl. New menu entry under Refresh (the regular one): "Deep refresh: per-fav status check (slow, ~20 min)". Spawns a daemon thread that walks every offline fav (= favs not currently in the bulk-online cache) and per-slug probes (1) get_edge_hls_url_ajax/ for room_status, (2) HEAD https://thumb.live.mmcdn.com/ri/<slug>.jpg for thumbnail availability. Rate-limited 1 second per slug = ~20 min for 1228 favs. Polite, well below CB's threshold. Persists into the model_meta DB via new upsert_status helper -- only writes the v2 status columns + updated_epoch, leaving rich data from regular auto-track upserts intact. Schema migration runs automatically on open_db: any DB at v1 gets the three new columns added via ALTER TABLE without losing existing rows. Lock-shared with the bulk refresh: clicking either while one is running toasts "already in progress" and exits cleanly. Final summary toast: "Deep refresh done: N ok, M gone, K errors". Statuses banned/deleted/gone get a HALO-red [GONE] prefix on the offline-favs label and TV-list label so accounts that aren't coming back are visually distinct from temporarily-offline models.
0.7.21 - URGENT loop unblock for the silent-stub path. v0.7.15 introduced the silent stub to suppress Kodi's "playback failed" dialog when a TV-mode slot resolved offline. Worked great for the dialog, but exposed a separate bug: when the silent stub plays, the loop iterates and pick_target re-picks the same offline slug (because the bulk-live cache still has her), so the stub plays again. Forever. Observed today: TV mode looped on a solo P12 tier of 'model_f' for ~6s per cycle, indefinitely. User had to play something else to break out.
Root cause: addon_actions._tv_bulk_mark_offline runs in playvid's process (Kodi spawns a separate default.py to resolve plugin URLs); the TV loop's _TV_BULK_CACHE lives in a DIFFERENT process. So playvid's mark-offline never reached the loop's cache. Cross-process state was the missing piece.
Fix: the TV loop now detects "we just played the silent stub" by checking player.tracked_file against the resources/media/silent.mp4 path. When that's true AND the inner monitor exited cleanly (no user stop, no takeover, no promotion), the loop extracts the slug from the playlist's current position and calls _tv_bulk_mark_offline IN-PROCESS so the next pick_target sees an empty (or different-priority) cache and either picks a different live slug or falls through to the screensaver. Self-healing on solo-tier offline.
Two new helpers + tests: _was_silent_stub_played and _slug_from_playlist_path. Diagnostic log now includes tracked_file= so future hangs are pinpoint-able.
The deep per-slug status crawl that was originally planned for v0.7.21 (last_room_status / [GONE] flagging via per-slug AJAX HEAD-the-thumbnail) is deferred to v0.7.22 -- this fix takes priority since the loop spin was actively bad UX.
0.7.20 - "Refresh offline model info" menu entry. Spawns a daemon thread that fires _tv_bulk_refresh on demand; the user sees a "Refreshing..." toast immediately and a "Done (N rooms)" toast when the bg work returns. Failures (network, sqlite) toast a "failed" message instead of a misleading "done". Lives between Refresh artwork and Restart Kodi in the main menu. Six TDD'd regression tests covering the success / failure / exception paths plus the new module-level _BULK_REFRESH_LOCK that serializes _tv_bulk_refresh callers (TV-loop auto-poll, favs view, manual click): non-blocking acquire so a second caller skips silently and returns False instead of double-fetching the 12 MB JSON. Manual handler additionally checks _BULK_REFRESH_LOCK.locked() before kicking off so the user gets a friendly "A refresh is already in progress" toast instead of a misleading "failed" if they click while an auto-poll is mid-fetch. 0.7.19 - Render offline favs and TV-list rows from the cached meta DB. New helpers in model_meta_store: image_for_row picks last_image_url > thumb > legacy; last_seen_ago_label formats "Xm" / "Xh Ym" / "Xd Yh" matching the Online line; plot_for_offline_row builds the left-pane plot with Subject / Age / Location / Watching / Followers / Last seen / Tags lines mirroring the live-side plot_for shape. favs_views.offline_favs_view now batched-reads meta for the displayed page and passes it to _render_favs which decorates each offline fav with cached thumbnail + plot + a (~N) "last viewers" label suffix. addon_actions.tv_list does the same and additionally appends a HALO-cyan "(Xh Ym ago)" suffix on the right of the model name so the TV list reads at a glance who's been offline for how long. All best-effort -- if the meta DB is missing or sqlite throws, every site falls back to the v0.7.18 bare rendering. 13 new render-helper tests in test_model_meta_store, all gates green. 0.7.18 - Foundation for offline-model rendering: new sqlite store at addon_data/model_meta.db that accumulates everything we ever see about every model from every API source. New module resources/lib/model_meta_store.py with 30+ columns covering the union of affiliate-onlinerooms (rich: display_name, spoken_languages, image_url, seconds_online, etc) and per-gender roomlist (display_age, start_timestamp, is_age_verified, has_password, private_price, etc) plus our own metadata (last_online_epoch, first_online_epoch, last_source). Upserts are sticky-on-non-null COALESCE so a partial later source can NEVER wipe richer data we collected from an earlier one -- every poll just overlays what it has. Hook in addon_actions._tv_bulk_refresh writes to the DB on every successful affiliate fetch (= every 10-min poll for free, no extra HTTP). Future v0.7.19 will use this store to render offline favs / TV-list / browse views with last-known thumbnails + subject + viewers + "Last seen" line, all without any per-render network calls. Future v0.7.20 will add a "Refresh offline model info" menu button to kick off a one-shot full sweep on demand. 16 new test_model_meta_store tests, all gates green: 571 passing, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean. 0.7.17 - "Online: Xh Ym" line now shows in EVERY browse view (Top Cams, New Cams, Female, Male, Couple, Trans, Search), not just Favorites and TV mode like in v0.7.16. v0.7.16 read seconds_online which only the affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint returns; the per-gender /api/ts/roomlist/ endpoint returns start_timestamp (Unix epoch of broadcast start) instead. New _seconds_online_from_room helper unifies both shapes -- prefers server-computed seconds_online, falls back to (now - start_timestamp) when only start_timestamp is present, returns 0 cleanly when neither field is present or start_timestamp is in the future (defensive against clock skew). plot_for accepts an optional now parameter for testability; production callers leave it at None and fall through to time.time(). Pinned with five new regression tests covering both API shapes and the edge cases. 💙 0.7.16 - Two UX polish items. (1) "Online: Xh Ym" line added to the model plot info on the left pane (the same dossier panel that shows Age/Location/Watching/Followers/Tags). Pulled from the affiliate API's seconds_online field which we already fetch but were ignoring. Format: under-1-min omitted (model just started, not useful), under-1-hour shows minutes ("47m"), under-1-day shows hours+minutes ("1h 51m"), at or above 1 day shows days+hours ("3d 14h", minutes drop at that scale). (2) Max resolution settings dropdown was rendering as random network-settings strings ("netmask", "appearance") on Kodi 21+. Root cause: I had <option label="Auto (server-picked)">auto</option> passing literal strings as labels, but Kodi 21+ treats label= as a strings.po ID, fails to resolve, falls back to random core strings. Fixed by switching to bare <option>auto</option> tags (matches the working screensaver_color pattern). Dropdown now shows auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p as plain values. 0.7.15 - URGENT real fix on the dialog-spam I claimed was fixed in v0.7.14 but wasn't. v0.7.14 changed setResolvedUrl to fire IMMEDIATELY with succeeded=False instead of letting Kodi wait 30s and time out. Wrong: setResolvedUrl(False) when the playlist has nothing else to play (solo-slug tier scenario) ALSO fires the "one or more items failed to play" dialog -- and worse, the modal blocks the addon's main thread. Observed today: TV loop went silent for 2h 43m waiting for the user to dismiss. v0.7.15 swaps to setResolvedUrl(handle, True, silent_stub) pointing at a bundled 1-second silent .mp4 (resources/media/silent.mp4, 2784 bytes). Kodi plays it, hits natural end, fires onPlayBackEnded, the loop iterates -- no dialog ever appears, no thread block. PlayerControl(Next) dropped because the natural end-of-stub advances the playlist on its own. Plus heavy diagnostic logging in tv_loop around xbmc.Player().play(), the wait-for-isPlaying loop, the inner monitor loop entry/exit, plus a 60s heartbeat in the inner loop with the current modal dialog id -- so if anything else wedges the main thread we'll see the gap and the dialog state in the log. Test inverted to assert succeeded=True with the silent_stub path and that PlayerControl(Next) is no longer fired. 0.7.14 - URGENT dialog-spam fix on the playvid TV-active-offline path. When TV mode was running a solo-slug tier and the model went offline mid-stream (sessionid expiry / stream end), playvid was firing PlayerControl(Next) and returning WITHOUT calling setResolvedUrl. Kodi sat for 30s waiting for the resolve, then showed "one or more items failed to play" with a sad-face dialog the user had to click OK to dismiss. Each loop iteration spawned another. Fix: still fire PlayerControl(Next) but ALSO call setResolvedUrl(handle, False, _empty_listitem()) so Kodi tears the resolve down cleanly. Two-line code change, regression test inverted to assert exactly one setResolvedUrl call on this path. The intentional Yes/No exit dialog in tv_loop._classify_after_stop is unaffected. 0.7.13 - Sticky-playback enforcement bundle. (1) Restored v0.7.11's working Yes/No dialog (no defaultbutton; v0.7.12's defaultbutton=1 broke focus on Kodi 21 - user couldn't highlight either button). Autoclose defaults to "Keep playing" so accidental walk-away preserves playback. (2) Dropped ALL double-press gestures (double-stop, double-tap-at-end-within-5s) per user directive: "like the double stop and the double next is a no go from now on" / "i never want to remove something that is there to keep it playing forever". classify_stop now ALWAYS returns natural-end on at_end -> rebuild forever. The exit gesture is the dialog (NOT-at-end user stops only) or the "Stop TV mode" menu item. (3) New ``dialog_timeout_seconds`` setting (default 10s, range 5-60) so users tune how fast the dialog auto-resumes after an accidental Stop. (4) New "Settings" menu entry at the bottom of the main menu - opens the addon's settings dialog directly via ``Addon.OpenSettings`` builtin (discoverable from inside the addon, no Kodi-settings-tree drilling). (5) Exit-confirmation notification on every user-driven exit ("TV mode exited" toast for user_stopped/screensaver_dismissed/active_flag_cleared/natural_end paths) so users know the exit took effect. (6) Async old-proxy cleanup (Lesson 34): in-line server.shutdown() blocked playvid for 5+s on stale in-flight requests, tripping Kodi's CPythonInvoker timeout. Cleanup now runs on a daemon thread - playvid returns immediately. Pinned with regression tests across the suite (544 passing). 0.7.12 - Two UX polish fixes on the exit flow: (1) Exit dialog now focuses the "Exit" button by default (defaultbutton=1) so a user who pressed Stop can confirm with a single OK press. Autoclose still defaults to "Keep playing" so accidental ignore preserves sticky-playback. (2) Exit-confirmation notification: every user-driven exit ("user_stopped", "screensaver_dismissed", "active_flag_cleared", "natural_end") now fires a "TV mode exited" notification from the finally block so the user knows the exit took effect. Skips for "aborted" (Kodi shutting down) and "errors_exhausted" (already noisy). "takeover" already had its own notification. 0.7.11 - Replaced the double-stop exit gesture (Lesson 29) with a Yes/No dialog (Lesson 33). User: "ther eis no way to hit stop a second time there is no way to get to stop fast / when nothing is playing stop is gone / i don't know where to even find stop a second time love even with a minute". The double-tap pattern was fundamentally broken when no playback was happening (between iterations / screensaver) because Stop button is unavailable then. Now: on a user-input stop where standard logic would continue, fire ``Dialog().yesno("Exit TV mode?", yeslabel="Exit", nolabel="Keep playing", autoclose=30s)``. Dialog is always reachable from any remote regardless of player state. Default focus on "Keep playing" + 30s autoclose so accidental dismiss preserves sticky-playback. The 5s double-stop force-exit branch is preserved as a fast-path for users who do spam Stop twice quickly. 0.7.10 - URGENT TV-mode resilience fix (Lesson 32). Two compounding bugs: (1) ``Action(Next)`` is the wrong builtin name on Kodi 21+ - logs ``Keymapping error: no such action 'next' defined``. Switched to ``PlayerControl(Next)`` which is the canonical playlist-advance builtin. (2) When playvid resolves offline AND TV mode is active, we now invalidate the bulk-live cache (drop the slug) BEFORE firing the skip. Without this, the loop's next pick_target re-picked the same offline slug for the rest of the poll cycle (~9.5 min default), each iter offline-skipping again, infinite tight loop on a dead model. Bug surfaced when a model went offline mid-stream and user got "Playback failed" with the loop stuck. Pinned with two regression tests. 0.7.9 - Closes two CRITICAL gaps surfaced by the -vs-chaturbatetv coverage audit (docs/-AUDIT.md). (1) start_proxy now auto-stops any previously-tracked proxy before standing up a new one - was leaking daemon threads on every replay because no caller called .stop() on the old handle. New module-level _active_proxy tracker enforces cleanup at the boundary. (2) STOP REINFORCED added to the chunklist exception path - if upstream fails AND state.stopping/terminal is set, fire PlayerControl(Stop) immediately instead of trying cache fallback. Catches the race where reconnect just exhausted but ISA is firing chunklist requests faster than the bg-thread's force-stop reaches Kodi. Lesson 31 captured. 0.7.8 - PlayerControl(Stop) hammer fires from THREE places now (was only one). 's _force_stop is called from: (1) the chunklist handler when terminal-state requests hammer us [0.7.7], (2) the background reconnect thread when retries exhaust [NEW], (3) the watchdog when ISA goes silent after a successful reconnect [NEW]. Without the bg-thread fires, if ISA gave up on its own first, Kodi's player stayed stuck on the last frame with a buffer wheel forever. New module-level _force_player_stop(state) helper shared between all three sites. User audit: "i feel like we didn't bring over all the knowledge and hard fought battles from " - this lands one of the gaps. Lesson 30 documents the pattern. 0.7.7 - URGENT: terminal-chunklist retry loop FINALLY fixed (third attempt). 0.7.3 served empty ENDLIST: ISA "No segments" -> retry. 0.7.4 served HTTP 410: ISA "Download failed" -> retry. ISA respects neither for chunklists. The working pattern ('s, battle-tested for years): serve a finished-VOD playlist body (PLAYLIST-TYPE:VOD + a placeholder #EXTINF + ENDLIST) AND fire ``xbmc.executebuiltin('PlayerControl(Stop)')`` from the handler to tear the player down. Rate-limited to 1/sec so Kodi's event queue doesn't drown if 30+ retries hit in a single second. User: "its hung again love / like before with the buffer wheel" - same shape, different code path, same root cause. 0.7.6 - TV mode list now actually shows highest-priority on top. User: "the shorting on tv is in reverse like the lows are at the top and highs at the bottom love is that by design" - it was not. Our priority_sort produced a correct descending list, but Kodi alpha-sorted the labels by default (the [P##] prefix made [P01] sort above [P17] alphabetically/numerically). Fix: pass unsorted=True to end_directory which adds SORT_METHOD_UNSORTED so Kodi keeps our insertion order. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.5 - Discoverable double-stop exit (Lesson 29). User can't easily exit TV mode via the player's Stop button when conditions don't fit the Lesson-17 disambiguator (model went offline, idle high, etc) - by design (we want playback persistence). Now when the user hits Stop and we'd normally continue: show a 5-second notification "Hit Stop again within 5s to exit TV mode" and arm a follow-up trigger. Second Stop within the window = force exit, bypassing the disambiguator. Outside the window = resets to first-stop behavior. Existing Lesson-17 ISA-misfire guard preserved (model_live check stays - keep playback sticky in normal cases). 0.7.4 - URGENT: chunklist terminal/no-cache paths return HTTP 410 instead of empty ENDLIST body. Empty ENDLIST manifest had no segments, so ISA logged "ParseChildManifest: No segments in the manifest" and re-fetched immediately, producing a 100+ req/sec tight retry loop on = the long-spinning buffer wheel. 410 matches the segment terminal-path behavior and tells ISA "permanently gone, stop retrying." Two regression tests pin the new contract for terminal flag and no-cache fallback paths. 0.7.3 - URGENT: TV mode now falls back to per-slug AJAX when the affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint times out on cold start. Real-world scenario tonight: chaturbate's affiliate API slowed to 30s+ timeouts, TV mode dead-started with no cached slugs. Without a fallback, every is_live call returned False and pick_target found no live targets. With the fallback, when bulk fails AND cache is empty, we hit cb_client.is_model_live(slug) per-query for THIS call only; subsequent calls retry bulk first so we recover automatically when the affiliate endpoint comes back. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.2 - TV mode list rows finally carry the state-aware ctxmenu (Edit TV Priority + Remove from TV + Add to / Remove from Favorites). Regression from - previous tv_list rendering passed nothing to ctx_items so right-clicking a TV entry showed an empty menu. Pinned with regression test. 0.7.1 - refresh_artwork now walks every Textures*.db it finds (Kodi 21+ bumped to Textures14.db; older addons targeted Textures13.db only). Forward-compat for whatever schema bump comes next. Tolerates schema-mismatched DBs gracefully (skip with log, don't crash). Added regression tests for both the dual-DB walk and the schema-mismatch skip path. 0.7.0 - Tier-Next button no longer stops TV mode (real bug, not by design): clicking Next in the player to switch between live tier members was firing TAKEOVER because the queued plugin URLs got resolved to localhost proxy URLs before onAVStarted saw them, so the "is this in our queue?" check always failed. Fixed with a playlist-coherence fallback: if path is 127.0.0.1 AND playlist size matches queued count AND position is valid, treat as internal advance. User direct-play (which replaces the playlist) still fires takeover correctly. Plus three new features: max_resolution setting (auto / 1080p / 720p / 480p) caps ISA's variant pick to reduce buffering on slow edges. Two new menu items at the bottom of the main menu: "Refresh artwork" clears Kodi's Textures13.db cache for the addon (icon/fanart never auto-refresh after an update); "Restart Kodi" runs Quit (LibreELEC respawns) to clear stuck audio renderer state without ssh. 0.6.9 - TV mode now uses the same single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint as Online Favorites for live-set detection. Was doing 60 sequential per-slug AJAX calls per poll cycle; now 1 affiliate fetch with TTL aligned to poll_minutes. Network failure keeps the stale slug set so a transient 5xx doesn't mark every model offline. Plus: hls_proxy startup race fixed (refresh/trigger callback closures now populated BEFORE thread.start() instead of after - a request landing in the gap was calling None()). Pure-store modules (tv_store, favs_store) now log load/save events. fav_add and fav_remove get entry/exit log lines. Stale docstrings in cb_client and cb_resolve updated. New tests/test_color_regression.py walks every emitted [COLOR] tag and pins Lesson 4 (8-char AARRGGBB only). Four new lessons added to docs/LESSONS-LEARNED.md (21-24). 0.6.8 - Browse views now client-side sort by viewers descending. The room-list API returns rooms in mixed order (top ~8 high-traffic then a roughly random tail) - same behavior has, neither addon was sorting. Top Cams / Female / Male / Couple / Trans / Search now show most-watched on top, walking down. New Cams left alone (recently-online ordering is the point). Plus: per-gender toggles in settings (Show Female / Show Male / Show Couple / Show Trans, all default on). Toggle off any category you don't want cluttering the main menu. Favorites and TV mode lists are NOT filtered by these toggles - those are personal collections you picked yourself. 0.6.7 - URGENT: dropped the on-disk bulk-fetch cache. Versions 0.6.3 - 0.6.6 cached the slug set (only) on disk for 30 minutes; on a disk-cache hit the online favs rendered WITHOUT thumbnails or plot info because the model-rich data was in-memory only. Now memory-only cache (30s TTL); each Online Favorites entry past the TTL does a fresh single-call affiliate fetch which is sub-second anyway. Legacy ``bulk_live_cache.json`` files get cleaned up on first call. Online favs render with thumbnails + viewer counts + plot info on every fresh fetch. 0.6.6 - Switched bulk-fetch to chaturbate's single-call affiliate-onlinerooms endpoint ('s pattern). Was walking 50 pages of /api/ts/roomlist/ at 100/page (5-10s); now does ONE GET to /affiliates/api/onlinerooms/?format=json&wm=XXX which returns ALL online rooms in a single ~7MB response. Same coverage, sub-second response. In-memory cache TTL dropped from 5min to 60s since each fresh fetch is now fast. Watermark rotates from 's array (matches the user's pre-existing affiliate distribution). Plus new cb_listing.parse_affiliate_onlinerooms parser since field shape differs (username/image_url/room_subject vs slug/img/subject). 0.6.5 - Online favorites now render with thumbnails, viewer count, and plot info on the left (matching the browse views) - the bulk room-list fetch already had the live-model data, we just weren't propagating it to the ListItem. Offline favorites stay as bare entries by design (we deliberately don't poll 1000+ slugs to get stale metadata; offline rooms have no live data to show anyway). Plus: docs sweep - LESSONS-LEARNED gets six new entries (15 API limit drift, 16 top-level menu network ban, 17 paginated rendering, 18 busy-dialog dismiss, 19 hot-path log noise, 20 long-running plugin invocation spinner). README + PLANNING current-state blocks updated. 0.6.4 - URGENT API contract fix: chaturbate's room-list API now caps limit at 100 (was 500); every bulk fetch was getting HTTP 400 'Bad Request' and Online Favorites showed empty even with live models in the user's list. Lowered _BULK_PAGE_LIMIT to 100, raised _BULK_MAX_PAGES to 50 to keep coverage at ~5000 rooms. Pinned with regression test. Plus: dismiss any lingering Kodi busy dialog at TV mode + favs entry points ('s pattern - prevents the "stuck spinner over playing video" UX after a previous slow invocation). 0.6.3 - URGENT favorites fix: 1224-fav library locked up the UI on . Top-level Favorites menu no longer triggers a network call (just shows Online/Offline drill-downs); bulk room-list fetch is deferred to category open. Online/Offline views paginate at 50 entries per page so the directory render doesn't choke on 1000+ rows. Bulk-fetch now has a politeness pacer between page calls AND a 30-min on-disk cache so re-entering Favorites after a Kodi restart is instant. Per-segment / per-chunklist hls_proxy "OK" log lines dropped (1+/sec was flooding the feature log during steady-state playback); errors and reconnects still log. 0.6.2 - QA HIGH bundle: HLS proxy now rewrites EXT-X-RENDITION-REPORT URI in chunklist bodies (LL-HLS quality-switch fetches were going direct to chaturbate edges and getting 403'd). chaturbatetv_active literal centralized in tv_state.ACTIVE_KEY (was duplicated across tv_loop, addon_actions). TV playlist URLs now derive slug from TVEntry.url instead of using the display name (broke playback for any user-customized name; ``Alice the Cam Star`` was being passed where ``alice`` belonged). Migration tool no longer crashes when source favorites.db lacks the expected schema (table missing, wrong columns, etc). 0.6.1 - QA fix bundle: Search row routes to mode=search_prompt (was a dead route to the renderer that closes on empty query). TV-mode offline auto-skip lands (Lesson v6.1) - when the active TV playlist hits an offline slug, fire Action(Next) so the player advances instead of sitting on a black screen. Settings.xml entries finally read in production: poll_minutes (TV loop interval), isa_proxy_port (fixed-port option for locked-down LANs), screensaver_color (cyan / green / hotpink). New addon_settings module centralizes the read+clamp+default behavior. 0.6.0 - Phase 5: TV mode lands. _TVPlayer subclass with state-reset between iterations (Lesson 10), file-switch takeover detection (Lesson 11), idle-time disambiguator at the stop site (Lesson 17), random-tier pick (Lesson 14). Idle screensaver via xbmcgui.Window (NOT WindowDialog - Lesson 20) with HALO cyan bouncing label, periodic re-walk every 60s. tv_play / tv_stop / tv_list / tv_add / tv_remove / tv_edit verbs all wired through tv_store. Browse + favs rows now show a state-aware right-click menu (Add to TV vs In TV / Edit / Remove; Add to Favorites vs Remove from Favorites). Verbose logging gated on enh_debug across the new modules. 0.5.0 - Phase 4c: HLS proxy hardened with the eleven PR #1818 lessons.
